report.explanation: Operator hypothesis of a faulty deployment causing checkout errors is not supported by current telemetry. Traces show all checkout, order, payment, inventory and postgres spans returning 200 with no errors. Metrics show order v1.0.0 serving /v1/orders 200s with zero 502s, and the deployment record only proves version 1.0.0 with no prior version. No evidence establishes a bounded root cause; logs were excluded and are needed.
missing_evidence: Order service logs (ev-...-logs-order) were excluded from context; needed to check for errors or exceptions during checkout.
Error-rate or 5xx metrics across checkout/payment/inventory services to confirm whether checkout errors actually occurred.
Deployment history for services other than order (checkout, payment, inventory) to test the deployment hypothesis.
Trace or metric evidence of failed requests, since current traces show only successful 200 responses.
